hero.eyebrow: For friends, teams, families and couples
hero.title: Your schedule, your plans and your people, in one place.
hero.text: Share your week, find free time together, set up the meetup, split the work. All right next to the chat you're already having.

problem.text: Schedules in the calendar, plans in the chat, tasks in a notes app. Yakın Çevrem brings them together.

how.title: From schedules to plans in three steps

add.title: Add your week
add.text: Classes, work, gym; enter your week once and it repeats.

plan.title: Plan it or put it to a vote
plan.text: One tap for a meetup or a date poll.

try.title: Let's find a free slot together
try.text: Pick who's coming; the times everyone is free turn green. Tap one and the meetup is set.
try.none: This group has no shared free time this week. Try leaving someone out.
try.invited: {people} invited; their replies will show up here.
try.cta: Do this with your real schedules
try.note: This is a small demo; in the app, schedules fill up with everyone's real week, and you choose who sees what.

who.title: One app for everyone in your life
who.legend: Choose who you'll use it with

friends.label: With friends
friends.title: The group plan, in one place
friends.text: Who's free, who's coming Saturday, who's bringing what? Find the time, run a vote, talk it over.

team.label: With your team
team.title: Always know who did what
team.text: Add your team to a project, pick your method, assign the work. Finished work goes for review and the lead approves it. Board, timeline and guided planning tools are ready.

family.label: With family
family.title: Share the household load
family.text: Groceries, chores, medicine time. In the Agenda everyone sees who took what and who finished it; your phone reminds you when it's time.

couple.label: With your partner
couple.title: Your shared notebook
couple.text: Shared plans and everyday tasks; plus a space just for you two: memories, games, the daily question.

topics.title: A place for everything
topics.text: Six areas, one app. Start with whichever you're curious about.

cards.schedule: Everyone's week side by side, free time in one tap.
cards.plans: Meetups, date polls and your everyday tasks.
cards.projects: Method, guided tools, board, approvals and timeline.
cards.chat: Tag the plan in chat so everyone's on the same page.
cards.couples: Shared plans, memories and games, just for you two.

fresh.title: What's new in recent versions?
fresh.text: The app keeps growing. A few of our favourite recent additions:

tools.label: Guided project tools
tools.title: From idea to plan, question by question
tools.text: Persona, SWOT → TOWS, Lean Canvas, MVP scope and five more. You choose the method; the app explains what each tool is for.

export.label: Export for AI
export.title: Hand your plan to an AI in one file
export.text: Turn the project into a Markdown document; names can become roles, and gaps and open questions are listed.

live.label: Live meetups
live.title: It's started; who's here?
live.text: Time elapsed, time left and who has arrived, on everyone's screen. Running late? +30 min. Done? "End".

agenda.label: Agenda
agenda.title: Your everyday tasks in one list
agenda.text: Groceries, dated tasks, timed routines like medicine, and a water reminder based on your weight.

search.label: Search
search.title: Find anything with one search
search.text: People, meetups, projects, task numbers, pages and the Agenda; accents and capitals don't matter.

pricing.title: Everything is free today. Pro will add calls.
pricing.text: Everything in the app today is free and will stay free. Pro will only add voice and video calls: get it for yourself or share the subscription with your people.

free.name: Basic
features: Schedule, shared free time and meetups

duo.name: Pro Duo
features: One of you buys, both of you get Pro
Face to face, even when apart

group.name: Pro Group
features: Pro for up to five people, one subscription
Voice and video calls for everyone
For a family, a project team or a group of friends

work.title: For teams and freelancers
work.text: A client space, time tracking and a team workspace are on the roadmap. We haven't decided yet whether they will be paid; when we do, we'll say so clearly here.

pricing.note: Pro isn't in the app yet. We'll announce the price, trial and how to get it when Pro arrives; planned, may change.

soon.title: What's next?
items: Income and expense planning for projects, and a "how do I get my app built?" guide
An Upcoming view in the Agenda and streaks for routines
Recurring meetups; turn a finished meetup into a memory in one tap
soon.text: What's coming to the app next.

web.eyebrow: On the way: the web version
web.title: Soon in your browser, too.
web.text: We're building a web version of Yakın Çevrem. At your desk, you'll reach your schedule, plans and chats with the same account.

account.title: Same account, same people
account.text: Whatever is on your phone is on your computer, nothing extra to install.

wide.title: Your week on a big screen
wide.text: See your schedule and shared free time in one roomy table.

desk.title: Plan from your desk
desk.text: Write, assign and tick things off while you study or work, without reaching for your phone.

web.note: Planned; timing and scope may change. Right now the app is Android-only.
web.notify: Tell me when web is ready

finalCta.title: "What are we doing this week?" Now in one place.
finalCta.text: Your people are already there. Let your plans be too.
